families.existing_downstream_protection: Two credential tiers, local/provider registry, scoped secrets, session/kanban/HOME/venv authority, passthrough owner and bridge-specific controls retained. BaseEnvironment and remote backend behavior remain unchanged.
families.actual_gap: Adapter/OAuth/dashboard/plugin declarations could escape child filters or fail open; launch credentials and persisted shell exports could cross served-profile authority; Raft/OpenViking children inherited unfiltered or profile-home state.

RED_test.exclusions: Missing mock symbol, wrong returncode key, and snapshot test names lacking protected suffix are fixture errors, not RED. Import/syntax failures and WinError206 during the first all-name snapshot implementation are not GREEN. Invalid-identifier/argv assertions now use protected names and are killed by M09/M10.

families.minimum_change: Extend existing child env owners with strict late-bound declarations and stable launch-profile identity; preserve general SDK credentials and approved command-provider credentials through the same factory; route profile-owned values before tier filtering; validate and pin identical local snapshot bytes; use an operation-scoped declaration policy/fingerprint while including restoration history in readonly refusal; retain parallel execution, ordinary explicit env precedence and shared atomic snapshot dumps. Refuse malformed/dangling placed declarations, shell identifiers and argv overflow. Explicit adapter bridge token/profile and real HOME; no remote/BaseEnvironment implementation change.

regression_suite.snapshot_owner_exclusions: Four unmodified POSIX-only failures reproduced at D_BASE, recorded in S03-base-snapshot-existing-baseline.log. POSIX getpgid interrupt fixture is unsupported on Windows and excluded, not PASS; actual native timeout/spawn-failure cleanup is covered in the native family suite. Historical subset run 88 PASS/7 SKIP is intermediate; the final combined 27-file run covers the supported snapshot owners without duplicate counts.

known_baseline_failure.reason: Existing Windows LF/CRLF byte-writer mismatch; unrelated env-writer not modified. Explicitly deselected, never counted as PASS.

E2E.positive: Served-profile benign values, bridge's required own token/profile, real HOME and ordinary shell exports retained.
E2E.negative: Gateway/provider/plugin/other-profile secret absent; unbound credential scope or declaration failures refuse; byte-pinned and historically readonly snapshots cannot restore foreign authority; new declaration between wrap/spawn refuses; protected invalid names/Windows argv overflow refuse before spawn. Broken Windows junction refuses; file-link lstat semantics are unit-modelled because native symlink creation returned WinError1314, which is neither RED nor PASS.
E2E.resources: Candidate-bound native ledger: before/after owned processes, remaining observed identities and owned listeners all zero. PID/create_time guarded fixture cleanup includes wrapper identity before initialization wait and descendants during polling. Existing BaseEnvironment Windows timeout kills its direct shim but can leave MSYS children; this family does not change that product owner. Fixture owns and cleans its separate probe, and polling can miss short-lived children. Final campaign audit remains separate.
